answer: The standard working week at Northwind Labs is 38 hours [1]. This is normally spread over five days [1].

Employees must be available during core collaboration hours, which are from 10:00 to 15:00 local time [2]. Outside of these core hours, employees may arrange their schedules freely provided their team agrees [2].
Overtime worked on public holidays is compensated as time off in lieu at a rate of 1.5 hours per hour worked [2].
Full-time employees accrue 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year [3].
Employees can carry over a maximum of five vacation days into the following year [3]. Any remaining balance above five days expires on 31 March of the following year [3].
A medical certificate is required from the third consecutive day of sickness [1].
Employees may work remotely for up to three days per week after completing their probation period [1].

Working from another country is allowed for a maximum of 20 working days per calendar year [1]. Such arrangements must be registered with HR at least two weeks before departure because of tax and insurance rules [1, 2].

After completing probation, employees receive a one-off home office allowance of 300 euros paid with their first salary [1]. Additionally, employees may order an ergonomic chair, an external monitor, and a keyboard and mouse set from the approved catalogue [1].
No, the company does not pay for alcohol, which is never reimbursed [1]. Meal expenses while travelling exclude alcohol [1].
The nightly limit for hotel bookings in London is 250 euros [1].
Each employee receives an annual learning budget of 1,500 euros [1]. This budget can be used for courses, certifications, conference tickets, and technical books [1].

When resigning after probation, the notice period is three months, unless the employment contract specifies otherwise [1].
Remaining annual leave should ideally be taken during the notice period [2]. If taking the remaining days is not possible, unused days are paid out with the final salary [2].
Business travel expenses must be submitted through the finance portal within 30 days of the trip [1].
Company account passwords must contain at least 14 characters [1].
No, SMS codes are not accepted as a second factor for multi-factor authentication [1].
Administrators are required to use hardware security keys as a second factor [1].
Passwords are not rotated on a fixed schedule [2]. They only need to be changed immediately if a compromise is suspected [2].
Customers' personal data is classified as Restricted data [1]. Restricted data may only be stored in the approved data platform located in the EU region [1].

Your screen must lock automatically after five minutes of inactivity [1].
USB storage devices are blocked by default [1]. However, they can be enabled for a maximum of seven days upon request [1].
Managers review the access rights of their team every quarter [1].
Accounts of departing employees are disabled on their final working day by 18:00 [4].

Severity 1 represents the most severe incident level, which covers confirmed breaches of Restricted data or ransomware [1]. For this severity level, the incident commander must be paged immediately, and the executive team must be informed within two hours [1].
Production databases are backed up every six hours [1].
The recovery time objective for critical systems is eight hours [1].
Vendor access to internal systems is granted for a maximum of 30 days and is renewable [1].
Employees who click a simulated phishing link are assigned a short follow-up module and are not disciplined [2].

The CloudBox S2 enclosure is covered by a limited hardware warranty of three years from the purchase date [1]. Supplied drives are covered for two years, and the power adapter is covered for one year [1].
Yes, the drives supplied with the CloudBox S2 are covered under warranty for two years [1].

Data stored on the device is never covered by the warranty [1]. Northwind Devices is not responsible for lost data and does not perform data recovery under the warranty [1]. Customers are strongly advised to keep a second backup of important files [1].
No, damage caused by liquid is not covered by the warranty [5].
Products bought directly from the Northwind Devices online store can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund [5].
The customer pays return shipping unless the device is faulty [1].
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 14 days after the returned device has been inspected [1].

To start a warranty claim, you must open a return merchandise authorisation request in the support portal [1]. Support will then conduct a remote diagnosis with you [1]. If the fault is confirmed, a prepaid shipping label will be emailed to you within two working days [1].
For the first year of the warranty, an advance replacement service is available where the replacement is shipped first and you return the faulty unit within 14 days [1].
If you do not return the faulty unit within 14 days after receiving an advance replacement, a fee of 120 euros is charged [3].
Security updates for the CloudBox S2 firmware are provided for at least five years after the product was last sold [2].
Firmware updates install automatically between 02:00 and 05:00 local time, unless automatic updates are switched off in the settings [1].
Installing unofficial firmware does not, by itself, void the hardware warranty [1], [3]. However, it does void the software support [1], [3].
The CloudBox Care plan costs 39 euros per year [1].

Northwind Cloud commits to a Monthly Uptime Percentage of at least 99.95 percent for Enterprise subscriptions [2].
Downtime is defined as a period lasting at least five consecutive minutes during which the platform API returns server errors for more than five percent of requests [3].
For Business subscriptions, uptime below 99.0 percent earns a 25 percent credit [1].
Service credits must be requested through a support ticket within 30 days after the end of the affected month [1].
Service credits are the sole remedy for missed availability and cannot be exchanged for cash [1].
For Business subscriptions, the first response target for Priority 1 issues (meaning the production service is down or unusable for all users) is one hour [1].
Enterprise subscriptions receive a 15-minute first response for Priority 1 support requests, which are available around the clock [1].

If a Priority 1 issue is not resolved within four hours, customers may escalate to the duty engineering manager [1]. This escalation is done through the escalation number available in the console [1].
Routine maintenance takes place on Sundays between 01:00 and 05:00 UTC [1].

Customers are notified of routine maintenance at least seven days in advance through the status page and by email [1]. Emergency maintenance to fix critical security vulnerabilities may be performed with 24 hours' notice [1].

After a subscription ends, customer data remains available for export in standard formats for 30 days [1]. Following this 30-day export period, the data is permanently deleted within an additional 30 days [1].
No, the commitments and uptime guarantees in the agreement do not apply to features labelled as preview or beta [1].
Root cause analysis reports for Priority 1 incidents are published within five business days [2].
